title: Fernhill Books & Tax
brief: We're Fernhill Books & Tax, a three-person firm in Portland, Oregon: Grace Lindqvist, CPA, plus an enrolled agent and a bookkeeper. We want to be known as the accountants for independent restaurants, cafés and food carts, and move away from one-off $200 tax returns. Packages: Monthly Books from $450 a month (bookkeeping and reconciliations, payroll coordination, a one-page monthly report), Books + Tax from $750 a month (adds quarterly estimates and the business and owner returns), and Cleanup projects quoted after a free 20-minute call. The main goal is booking that call. We take new clients from May to December only; during tax season we serve existing clients, so say that plainly. Only Grace is a CPA, so don't call the whole team CPAs. Never collect tax documents through a website form: point clients to our secure portal (link to add). Phone (503) 555-0119, office hours Monday to Thursday 9am–5pm. No client logos or testimonials.
